trailhead.label: The play area of Valdaora di Sotto, by the stone arch on Via Rienza, the board’s start

cautions: About 90 m on Via Rienza at the start, open to cars: keep your dog on a short lead.
Short steep ramps (up to 18–20%) and loose stones in places.
Olang keeps dogs out of play areas and parks: the trail starts at a play area and passes another at the Fraktionshalle, so keep to the path.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
